Convert columns to factors with specification-controlled ordering

Source: R/factor.R
ysx_factors.Rd

Extends yspec::ys_factors() with a per-variable dots: {order: biggest} setting. order must be "first" or "biggest". Missing settings default to "first", preserving yspec's factor level order. "biggest" orders levels by decreasing frequency in the supplied data. Ties retain the original level order, and unused levels are retained at the end. Missing observations do not contribute to counts unless they are an explicit level.

Usage

ysx_factors(data, spec, ..., .keep_values = TRUE, .suffix = "_v")

Arguments

data

the data set to modify.

spec

a yspec object.

...

unquoted column names for modification; passing nothing through ... will signal for all columns to be considered for factors.

.keep_values

logical; if TRUE, value columns will be retained with a .suffix.

.suffix

a suffix to be added to original columns (holding values).

Value

The data frame with selected columns converted to factors.

Details

Selection, decoding, retained value columns and existing factors follow yspec::ys_factors(). In particular, existing factors are not reordered. Order settings are validated only for columns being converted. A warning is given when values that are not in the specification become NA.
